Standard: The air vehicle flying qualities in response to atmospheric disturbances are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle response to disturbance inputs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Pitch (Roll) Response to Disturbance Inputs, Short-term Yaw Response to Disturbance Inputs, Short-term Height Response to Disturbance Inputs, Short-term Position Response to Disturbance Inputs, Short-term Translational Rate Response to Disturbance Inputs paragraph in conjunction with qualitative results from piloted simulation for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle response to disturbance inputs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, for specified MTEs and other mission representative scenarios for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle response to disturbance inputs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742 for specified MTEs and other mission representative scenarios for selected combination of air vehicle configuration and loading with the SFE. A final adjudication of airworthiness with respect to disturbance rejection should consider both quantitative and qualitative criteria with greater credence given to qualitative results.
